description: A Dart test helper file that provides utility functions for Flutter widget testing and database setup, including frame pumping, waiting for animations, and cleanup routines.

methods.name: initSqfliteFfiForTests
methods.description: Initializes the sqflite plugin to use the FFI implementation for testing, marking it as idempotent.

methods.name: pumpFrames
methods.description: Pumps a fixed number of Flutter frames to simulate passage of time in widget tests.

methods.name: assertNoScheduledFramesAfterPumps
methods.description: Pumps frames and asserts that no frames are scheduled afterward, ensuring the framework is idle.

methods.name: pumpAndSettleBounded
methods.description: Pumps frames repeatedly until the framework becomes idle or a timeout occurs, with a fallback frame drain.

methods.name: unmountWidgetTree
methods.description: Unmounts the current widget tree completely and waits for the system to settle.

methods.name: disposeAppDependencies
methods.description: Cleans up app dependencies, such as cancelling download engines and closing the database.
